question:
Match the dance with its core tribe/community.

 
 

 Folk dance
 Song-theme
 
 
 
 

 1. Panthi
 A. Devotional hymns to Guru Ghasidas (Hari-Gaitri)
 
 

 2. Gotipua
 B. Krishna-Jagannath leela narratives
 
 

 3. Kalbelia
 C. Sensuous serpent metaphors
 
 

 4. Tippani
 D. Work-song pounding couplets (saathiyo re)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Panthi Dance:** It is associated with the Satnami community of Chhattisgarh and is performed as a devotional offering to Guru Ghasidas, the founder of the sect.
 
• The dance is characterized by songs and hymns dedicated to Hari-Gaitri, emphasizing themes of spirituality and devotion.
 
• It is often performed during religious occasions and festivals, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of the Satnami sect.
 
• Panthi dance involves energetic movements and symbolic gestures, representing the community’s faith and reverence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gotipua Dance:**

 
 
• Gotipua is a traditional dance form from Odisha, performed by young boys dressed as girls.
 
• The dance narrates leelas of Lord Krishna and Lord Jagannath through intricate movements and expressions.
 
• It is considered a precursor to the classical Odissi dance form, with its roots in temple rituals and devotional performances.
 
• The dancers exhibit remarkable flexibility and agility, showcasing acrobatic poses and rhythmic footwork.
 
 
 
• **Kalbelia Dance:**
 
 
• Kalbelia is a folk dance of Rajasthan, associated with the Kalbelia community, traditionally known for their snake-charmer heritage.
 
• The dance reflects the sensuous and fluid movements inspired by serpents, embodying the community’s close connection to nature.
 
• Kalbelia dancers wear vibrant costumes adorned with intricate embroidery, and the music includes traditional instruments like the pungi and dholak.
 
• UNESCO has recognized Kalbelia dance as an Intangible Cultural Heritage, highlighting its significance in preserving tribal traditions.
 
 
 
• **Tippani Dance:**
 
 
• Tippani is a folk dance from Gujarat, performed primarily by women laborers while pounding floors with long wooden sticks.
 
• The songs accompanying the dance are work-themed couplets, often reflecting the daily struggles and camaraderie of the laborers.
 
• It is typically performed during community gatherings, festivals, or celebrations, showcasing the spirit of unity and hard work.
 
• The rhythmic pounding and synchronized movements create a visually captivating performance.
